mapper.insert: INSERT INTO REVIEW (MEMBER_ID, PRODUCT_ID, ORDER_ITEM_ID, RATING, CONTENT, IMAGE_URL ) VALUES ( #{memberId}, #{productId}, #{orderItemId}, #{rating}, #{content}, #{imageUrl} )
mapper.select: SELECT r.REVIEW_ID, r.MEMBER_ID, r.PRODUCT_ID, r.ORDER_ITEM_ID, r.RATING, r.CONTENT, r.CREATED_AT, m.MEMBER_NAME, r.IMAGE_URL FROM REVIEW r JOIN MEMBER m ON r.MEMBER_ID = m.MEMBER_ID WHERE r.PRODUCT_ID = #{productId} AND r.STATUS = 'VISIBLE' ORDER BY r.CREATED_AT DESC

SELECT r.REVIEW_ID, r.MEMBER_ID, r.PRODUCT_ID, r.ORDER_ITEM_ID, r.RATING, r.CONTENT, r.CREATED_AT, p.PRODUCT_NAME, r.IMAGE_URL FROM REVIEW r JOIN PRODUCT p ON r.PRODUCT_ID = p.PRODUCT_ID WHERE r.MEMBER_ID = #{memberId} AND r.CREATED_AT BETWEEN #{startDate} AND #{endDate} + INTERVAL 1 DAY ORDER BY r.CREATED_AT DESC

SELECT oi.ORDER_ITEM_ID, oi.PRODUCT_ID, oi.ORDER_ITEM_QTY, oi.ORDER_ITEM_PRICE, p.PRODUCT_NAME, o.ORDER_CREATED_AT AS orderDate, PI.IMAGE_SAVED_NAME FROM ORDER_ITEM oi JOIN ORDERS o ON oi.ORDER_ID = o.ORDER_ID JOIN PRODUCT p ON oi.PRODUCT_ID = p.PRODUCT_ID LEFT JOIN PRODUCT_IMAGE PI ON p.PRODUCT_ID = PI.PRODUCT_ID AND PI.IMAGE_TYPE = 'MAIN' WHERE o.MEMBER_ID = #{memberId} AND o.ORDER_CREATED_AT BETWEEN #{startDate} AND #{endDate} + INTERVAL 1 DAY AND o.ORDER_STATUS = 'DONE' AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM REVIEW r WHERE r.ORDER_ITEM_ID = oi.ORDER_ITEM_ID ) ORDER BY o.ORDER_CREATED_AT DESC

SELECT R.REVIEW_ID, M.MEMBER_ID, P.PRODUCT_ID, O.ORDER_ITEM_ID, R.RATING, R.CONTENT, R.CREATED_AT, P.PRODUCT_NAME, P.PRODUCT_PRICE, R.IMAGE_URL, M.MEMBER_NAME, PI.IMAGE_SAVED_NAME FROM REVIEW R LEFT JOIN ORDER_ITEM O ON R.ORDER_ITEM_ID = O.ORDER_ITEM_ID INNER JOIN MEMBER M ON R.MEMBER_ID = M.MEMBER_ID INNER JOIN PRODUCT P ON R.PRODUCT_ID = P.PRODUCT_ID LEFT JOIN PRODUCT_IMAGE PI ON PI.PRODUCT_ID = R.PRODUCT_ID AND PI.IMAGE_TYPE = 'MAIN' WHERE R.STATUS = 'VISIBLE' ORDER BY R.CREATED_AT DESC

SELECT COUNT(1) AS TOTAL, AVG(RATING) AS AVG_RATING, AVG(CASE WHEN R.CREATED_AT >= DATE_SUB(NOW(), INTERVAL 7 DAY) THEN R.RATING END) AS AVG_7RATING, AVG(CASE WHEN R.CREATED_AT >= DATE_SUB(NOW(), INTERVAL 30 DAY) THEN R.RATING END) AS AVG_30RATING, COUNT(CASE WHEN R.CREATED_AT >= DATE_SUB(NOW(), INTERVAL 7 DAY) THEN 1 END) AS COUNT_7, COUNT(CASE WHEN R.CREATED_AT >= DATE_SUB(NOW(), INTERVAL 30 DAY) THEN 1 END) AS COUNT_30 FROM REVIEW R

SELECT ROUND(AVG(RATING),1) AS avgRating, COUNT(*) AS totalCount, SUM(CASE WHEN RATING = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS one, SUM(CASE WHEN RATING = 2 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS two, SUM(CASE WHEN RATING = 3 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS three, SUM(CASE WHEN RATING = 4 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS four, SUM(CASE WHEN RATING = 5 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS five FROM REVIEW WHERE PRODUCT_ID = #{productId}

SELECT r.REVIEW_ID, r.MEMBER_ID, r.PRODUCT_ID, r.ORDER_ITEM_ID, r.RATING, r.CONTENT, r.CREATED_AT, r.STATUS, m.MEMBER_NAME, p.PRODUCT_NAME, r.IMAGE_URL FROM REVIEW r JOIN MEMBER m ON r.MEMBER_ID = m.MEMBER_ID JOIN PRODUCT p ON r.PRODUCT_ID = p.PRODUCT_ID ORDER BY r.CREATED_AT DESC
